scope: Diagnosis of the supplied 96% exploded view; application code was not modified.

causes.finding: Center-to-center progression overrides the head-pitch joint world Y axis with world Z; at 96%, neck_pitch moves 20.801 mm in Z relative to the upper neck motor.

The yaw_roll_motion bracket is treated as a thin Z part; its bearings already clear the motor AABB and receive no internal displacement. The two roll journal/inner-ring axes become 25.601 mm apart at 96%.
Parent attachments are inferred from proximity, without consulting the published connection endpoints.
The explosion planner receives part AABBs, bodies and joints, but no assembly interfaces or connections.

interpretation: These measurements identify a display-layout and assembly-readability defect. They do not establish that any single-axis physical disassembly path is required or validated.
